description: This file implements a simulation of a Least Frequently Used (LFU) cache eviction policy, including functions for managing entry counters, simulating access patterns, and visualizing cache entries.

methods.name: minutes_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between two 16-bit minute timestamps, accounting for wraparound.

methods.name: log_incr
methods.description: Logarithmically increments a counter with saturation at 255.

methods.name: access_entry
methods.description: Simulates an access to a cache entry, updating its counter and hit count.

methods.name: scan_entry
methods.description: Returns the LFU value of an entry and decrements it if the decrement interval has passed.

methods.name: show_entry
methods.description: Displays information about a cache entry, including its frequency, age, and hits.
